blocks.text: The Device Management page displays all the devices in your organization that have the Zscaler Client Connector deployed. You can select devices when you configure policies​​​​​.
The Devices page provides you with the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View the devices that have Zscaler Client Connector installed, including device name, OS, model, owner, device ID, etc.
Identify Zscaler Client Connector-managed devices to apply Internet & SaaS security policies.

blocks.text: On the Devices page (Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet & SaaS Device Management > Devices), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select a search parameter from the drop-down menu (e.g., Device Name).
Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all configured devices. For each device, you can view:
Device ID: The ID of the device.
Device Name: The name of the device.
Device Hostname: The hostname of the device. This field displays values only if you have configured Zscaler Client Connector to collect the hostname information.
OS Type: The OS type of the device.
OS Version: The OS version of the device.
Device Model: The model of the device.
Device Owner: The owner of the device.
Description: The description of the device.
View more information about the device.
Go to the Device Groups, VDI Devices, and VDI Device Groups pages.
